t.zh: 空子句里一个文字都没有，没有一项可能为真：它就是矛盾 ⊥。
t.en: The empty clause has no literal in it, nothing that could be true: it is the contradiction ⊥.

hint.zh: 「下雨」本身就是一条只有一项的子句。
hint.en: “It rains” is itself a clause of one literal.

brief.zh: 再从「我坐公交 ∨ 我骑车」「¬我坐公交 ∨ 我准时到」「¬我骑车 ∨ 我准时到」「¬我准时到」证明出 ⊥。
brief.en: Now prove ⊥ from “I take the bus ∨ I cycle”, “¬I take the bus ∨ I arrive on time”, “¬I cycle ∨ I arrive on time” and “¬I arrive on time”.

hint.zh: 两项相同的文字会并成一项。
hint.en: Two copies of the same literal merge into one.
